_comment: M6 T8 (part 1 review fix): a save taken mid-offer persists pending_consolidation but re-emits no consolidation_offered on load, so the prompt must RECONSTRUCT from sim state on world spawn (consolidation_prompt.gd _ready -> Game.sim.pending_offer_display()). Without the fix the player loads into a modal-but-invisible lockout (world/journal/pause all gate on pending_consolidation). Boots a fresh game, pause-Loads the pending_offer fixture (v3, warrior 6 + mage 7, pending_consolidation preset to the spellsword offer), asserts the prompt renders on load (ui_consolidation_prompt_rendered), then answers it (confirm = accept the default 'Consolidate' row) and confirms the deferred sleep beat resolves into [Spellsword] 9. Not reachable in normal play today (nothing autosaves while an offer is pending) -- this guards the persisted field against a future autosave-trigger/fixture change.
